Name: Gunther To Lil Nas X
Author: cookiesncrime
Description:
Alternate sprite for Mr. "Museum" Gunther

This mod overrides the Gunther image files without needing to replace the XNB.

~INSTALLATION~
1. Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
2. Download this mod
3. Extract the .rar into your "Mods" folder (found in C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods)
4. Run the game using SMAPI

~UNINSTALLATION~
1. Delete the folder from your "Mods" folder
